what_this_proves: The operator can take a multi-step, mixed desktop+browser task from one sentence and drive it as a closed loop: it observes before every decision, rebuilds the plan from what it sees, retries only what a declared taxonomy says is transient, climbs from the tree to a vision-located click exactly once and verifies that click by the tree, and otherwise stops and tells the owner which step, why and what it needs; the task is a durable row driven by a Temporal workflow, can be shown before it runs, paused, resumed and cancelled by voice or REST; and Settings, an Explorer folder, an Office document and an editor have plans that verify by something the action did not write.

measured_first.before: app/operator/task.py run_task: a fixed OperatorStep list, one pass, first failed postcondition ends the task; plans.py: 22 fixed plans, none for Settings/Explorer/Office/IDE; VisionProvider.describe only; no mission row, no workflow, no pause, no preview; 'Chrome'u aç ve YouTube'a gir' resolved to nothing a tool could do; the allowlist had no settings application on either side.

closed_fully.112_loop: mission.run_mission_step: observe (window.current+window.list) -> decide (DECIDERS by kind) -> run_task -> verify -> strategy; trail entry per round; MAX_ROUNDS_PER_STEP 6.

found_on_the_way.folder_search_stolen: corpus doc.search.5 ('İndirilenler klasöründe bütçe dosyasını arar mısın?') routed to mission_start; the explorer segment now requires an open verb and refuses ara/bul/oku/listele/göster.
found_on_the_way.one_registrar: test_the_registered_tools_are_the_declared_capabilities reads register_operator_tools; the mission tool is registered from there.
found_on_the_way.uwp_identity: a Settings window belongs to ApplicationFrameHost.exe; open_application recognises UWP_HOSTED_IMAGES by title.
found_on_the_way.fake_desktop_must_move: the first fake device kept Notepad in front after a launch and every loop test paused for the owner; the fake's foreground now follows the launch.
found_on_the_way.resume_wait_mutation: removing the workflow's resume wait finished the workflow before the test could observe 'paused' - red as intended (time-skipping environment).
found_on_the_way.adapter_example: test_operator_ui used winword.exe as the example of an unknown image; Word now has an adapter.
found_on_the_way.settings_noun_not_the_verb: the first settings segment matched any token starting with 'ayar', so 'Işığı ayarla' (scene) and 'Varsayılan konumu ayarla' (location) became missions (corpus scene.light.adjust x5, location.default.set x2); the segment now requires the NOUN (ayarlar/ayarlarda/ayarları/settings).
found_on_the_way.gate_run_1: the first full gate found two more: the self-model indexer reads a tool's name with ast and could not see operator.mission behind an imported constant (the tool now names itself with a literal held equal to the capability), and a file named ayarlar.json ('Bu dosyayı ayarlar-yedek.json adıyla kopyala', test_documents_b34) became a Settings mission because the settings segment needed only the noun - it now needs an OPEN verb and refuses file/copy/move/json words.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b39_mutate.py.
mutations: M1 an application already on the desktop is launched again instead of activated (113) -> 1 failure(s).
M2 a permission refusal is retried instead of handed to the owner (114/115) -> 1 failure(s).
M3 the loop never climbs to the visual rung (106/115) -> 1 failure(s).
M4 a missing vision provider is reported as a target not found, not as the provider missing (106) -> 1 failure(s).
M5 a preview mission runs without the owner's yes (130) -> 1 failure(s).
M6 a pause request between steps is ignored (129) -> 1 failure(s).
M7 a step's observed-value payload is never resolved, so a later step names no window (123/124) -> 1 failure(s).
M8 a second mission is accepted while one is in flight (128) -> 1 failure(s).
M9 a UWP-hosted window (Settings) is never recognised after its launch (123) -> 1 failure(s).
M10 every operator sentence becomes a mission, stealing APP_OPEN / TYPE_TEXT (127) -> 4 failure(s).
M11 the workflow resumes a paused mission on its own, without the owner's word (129) -> 1 failure(s).
red_first_proof.result: 11/11 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation.

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the loop over the scripted device (the same FakeDeviceAction that refuses a bad window id as the companion does), the workflow in the real Temporal test environment, the routes and the voice tool through create_app, the device-side allowlist through the compiled C# tests. The roadmap's PROVEN_REAL (a mixed browser+desktop mission verified end to end on the owner's desktop) and the lab measurement of the four new plans are READY_FOR_OWNER (checkpoint 16).
